fields.emailHint: To confirm your account and to reset a forgotten password. Other people never see it.

validation.usernameLength: Username must be between {{min}} and {{max}} characters
validation.usernameCharset: Username can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores
validation.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least {{min}} characters
validation.emailInvalid: That does not look like an email address

login.title: Welcome back!
login.subtitle: Log in to {{instance}}
login.inviteOnlyPrompt: This server is invite-only. Have an invite? <actionLink>Create your account</actionLink>

setup.title: No account exists yet
setup.body: This server is new and closed to the public, so nobody can register from the browser. Create the first administrator on the server, then sign in here:
setup.hint: Run the command in the install folder on the server. It prints a password once; use it to sign in.

suspended.title: This account is suspended
suspended.untilLifted: The suspension lasts until an administrator lifts it.

invite.closedNotice: Registration is invite-only on this instance. Paste your invite link or enter the code below.
invite.expired: This invite link has expired. Ask the admin for a new one.
invite.exhausted: This invite has reached its usage limit. Ask the admin to extend it.
invite.invalidLink: Invalid invite link. Please request a new one.
invite.required: An invite is required to register on this instance.

personalize.title: Make it yours
personalize.subtitle: Personalize your profile, or skip for now

errors.domainOnly: Enter a domain on its own, for example my-instance.com

invalid.title: Invalid Invite
invalid.description: This invite link is invalid or has expired.

join.invitedToRequest: You've been invited to ask to join

domain.label: Your instance domain
domain.redirectNote: You'll be redirected to your home instance to complete joining.

connect.passwordNote: Your password is checked by your home instance and is never sent to {{host}}. That instance gets a unique credential generated for it alone.

request.notice: This space takes join requests. A manager reviews each one before you can enter.
request.messagePlaceholder: Add a note for the managers (optional)
request.loginToAsk: Log in to ask to join

requestSent.title: Request sent to {{space}}
requestSent.pendingTitle: Your request to join {{space}} is waiting
requestSent.body: A manager will review it. The space appears in your list once they approve.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your confirmed email address. We send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If this address belongs to an account here and is confirmed, a link is on its way. It works for 30 minutes. Look in your spam folder too.
forgot.noMail: This server does not send email. Ask its administrator to reset your password.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Afterwards you sign in again, on every device.
reset.doneBody: Every device was signed out. Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidBody: It has expired or was already used. You can ask for a new one.

verify.title: Confirm your address
verify.subtitle: Click below to confirm this address for your account.
verify.doneBody: {{address}} is now confirmed for your account.
verify.invalidBody: It has expired or was already used. You can ask for a new one under Settings, Security.

mfa.title: Enter your code
mfa.subtitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the six-digit code.
mfa.subtitleRecovery: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each works once.
mfa.useCode: Use a code from your app instead
mfa.lost: Lost both? Only the operator of this server can help. A mail cannot get you past this step.
mfa.expired: That took too long. Enter your password again.
mfa.locked: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
mfa.remote: {{host}} asks for a code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
